note.en: HP and ATK stat recommendations differ for HP and ATK scaling DPS. HP scaling DPS want Robin Summeretto to have lots of SPD and more ATK than them to ensure CRIT DMG buffing. ATK scaling DPS want full HP% mainstats and Energy Regeneration Rope for more ATK buffing.
120+ SPD for ATK scaling DPS. 160+/180+ SPD for HP scaling DPS.
